sections.value:
Round-1 source addendum to security verdict 78ad32d.
Head: 81f4a89974383caf7dd5bf727f3f468c0d389ed2
The S237-001 BLOCK is unchanged.

The explicit takeover retirement at crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs:616-624
has durable effects beyond making the holder unavailable:
crates/store/src/registry.rs:80-90 marks pending FYIs dropped, and lines 91-94
release open number claims. Released numbers remain burned, not reusable.

Source-confirmed normal-use example, not executed: a Copilot parent process P
and its running omp -p child C share a pane but have different process tuples.
The parent's tool-shell connection passes the own-process ancestry gate.
The retirement filter excludes rows matching P's exact tuple, not descendants,
so C is still eligible and is tombstoned without a liveness check
(identity.rs:578-585,616-624). No unknown holder need be present.

Other requested checks were read:
- Automatic unknown handling excludes missing/invalid tuples, remote rows and
  probe failures from retirement (registration.rs:676-686).
- Automatic under-lock rechecks compare ownership (registration.rs:853,
  875-887,1728-1736). Explicit takeover uses full-descriptor transactional CAS
  (crates/store/src/registry.rs:61-75); unchanged does not imply dead.
- macOS lsof client-endpoint correlation and /bin/ps caller ancestry were
  reviewed statically (identity.rs:647-700), not executed locally.
- Banner rendering rebuilds the command from validated pane/holder fields,
  ignoring a remote command string (.copilot/extensions/pij/store.mjs:721-730,
  773-774).
- Takeover stores actor/reason through registry tombstoning, with no process
  signal or kill in that path (identity.rs:619-624).

Non-blocking command-help note, not another security vulnerability:
registration.rs:51 and store.mjs:774 print an unquoted --why <reason>
placeholder. This does not inject remote text, but the placeholder is not
shell-runnable; quote the example reason as requested in the review packet.

Test-proof limit: the added automatic-holder test covers missing/remote rows,
not an actual failed-probe result. The takeover test lacks the process-live
foreign-holder case required to catch S237-001. No optional hardening or
mutation testing is made a gate.

Prime-path status: caller correlation and contradictory-claim refusal were
read. Whether the existing stored-role prime gate is authoritative designation
or an inherited asserted-role gate is under narrow clarification; this note
does not certify it.
